items.entity: vertical load patch on right edge (Fig. 7 loading condition)
items.description: Sec. 3.3 / Fig. 7 caption only says both designs share 'the same loading condition'. The position index is never given for Fig. 7(a) and is visible only in the figure. Sec. 4.1 defines indices 1-18 as 2x2 blocks running top to bottom along the right edge. Table 1 has vf 0.3 at indices 1, 9, 17 and vf 0.5 at 4, 9, 13. Fig. 9 shows index 8.
readings: index 9: rows 17-18 from top, i.e. 0.444-0.500 of the height below the top edge (only index used for both vf 0.3 and 0.5 in Table 1)
index 8: rows 15-16, 0.389-0.444 of the height below the top (the case drawn in Fig. 9)
index 1: rows 1-2, 0-0.056 of the height (top-right corner)
index 17: rows 33-34, 0.889-0.944 of the height
any other index k in 1..18: rows 2k-1..2k, i.e. (k-1)/18 to k/18 of the height below the top

items.entity: uniformly distributed downward load on 2x2-element patch
items.description: Sec. 2.1 says the distributed load acts 'along the right edge'. Sec. 4.1 says it is uniformly distributed 'on a small area occupying 2x2 elements next to the right edge', and it is fed to the CNN as a per-pixel force image. The text never says how this becomes FE nodal loads: body force or edge traction, which nodes, and what weights.
readings: uniform body force on the 2x2 elements in the two right-most columns (x = 0.944-1.0 of the width), consistently lumped to its 3x3 nodes (corners F/16, mid-sides F/8, centre F/4)
equal nodal forces F/9 on all 9 nodes of the 2x2 patch
edge traction on the right boundary over the 2-element patch height: 3 right-edge nodes with F/4, F/2, F/4
equal forces F/3 on the 3 right-edge nodes of the patch

items.description: No passive solid or void elements are mentioned. Sec. 4.1 remarks that some NN designs have no material where the load is applied, which implies the load patch is designable. This is never stated for the FEM benchmark runs.
readings: no passive elements (whole domain designable)
2x2 loaded patch fixed solid (rho = 1)

items.description: Eq. (4) states an equality volume constraint. Eqs. (5)-(6) replace it with a term lambda*(mean rho - V0)^2 (gradient 2*lambda/N*(...)), and the 'Lagrange multiplier' lambda is never given. The text also does not say whether 0.3 applies to projected (physical) or unprojected densities.
readings: hard equality: mean physical (projected) density = 0.3
hard equality on unprojected design variables = 0.3
quadratic penalty lambda*(mean rho - 0.3)^2 with fixed or increasing lambda, final vf only approximately 0.3

items.description: Sec. 2 says a sensitivity filter (Bendsoe & Sigmund 2003) with radius 4 pixels is used, and that the Wang et al. (2011) projection with eta = 0.5 'can be used'. The text does not say whether projection was applied to the benchmark designs. It also does not say which field is projected when only a sensitivity filter (no density filter) is used.
readings: sensitivity filter (cone weights, rmin = 4) plus tanh projection (eta = 0.5) applied directly to the design variables
density filter (rmin = 4) followed by tanh projection (eta = 0.5), as in Wang et al. 2011
sensitivity filter (rmin = 4) only, no projection

items.description: Sec. 2 says only that 'beta is initially set as 1 and enlarges gradually'. The update rule, interval and maximum beta are not given.
readings: beta doubled every 25 iterations up to 32 (about 150 iterations total)
beta doubled every 50 iterations up to 8
beta doubled whenever max density change < 0.01, up to 64

items.description: Sec. 2, after Eq. (1), says 'p > 1 ... usually p = 3'. The p used for the cantilever designs, and whether any continuation was used, is not stated.
readings: p = 3 constant
continuation of p from 1 to 3 during the optimization

items.description: Sec. 2 says 'the gradient descent method used in this work' is applied to the unconstrained function of Eqs. (5)-(6). The step size, gradient scaling, move limit and handling of the bounds 0 <= rho <= 1 are not given.
readings: projected steepest descent on the normalized gradient with a fixed step (value unknown, e.g. 0.05), clipped to [0,1]
OC update with move limit 0.2 (88-line style)
MMA

items.description: No starting design is given for the FEM-based SIMP runs (Sec. 2, Sec. 4.1).
readings: uniform rho = 0.3 (target vf)
uniform rho = 0.5
uniform rho = 1.0

items.description: Sec. 2 says 'repeated until a convergence is achieved'. Sec. 4.1 only reports an average of 150 iterations per design. No tolerance or iteration cap is given.
readings: stop when max |delta rho| < 0.01
fixed 150 iterations
stop when relative objective change < 1e-4 after beta continuation ends

items.entity: discretization / domain used for the Fig. 7 designs
items.description: Sec. 3.3 and Fig. 7 give no domain or mesh information. The square 36x36 grid is stated only in Sec. 4.1, for the minimum-compliance problem. Other sizes appear elsewhere in the paper: 64x64, and '60x60' in the Summary.
readings: square domain, 36x36 square elements (Sec. 4.1 setting)
square domain at another resolution (e.g. 64x64) with the same 4-pixel filter radius

items.description: Sec. 4.1 says only 'uniform elements/pixels'. The element formulation and integration scheme are not stated.
readings: 4-node bilinear quadrilateral (Q4), 2x2 Gauss integration
8- or 9-node quadratic quadrilateral

items.description: Sec. 4.1 gives aluminium with E0 = 69 GPa and nu0 = 0.3, but never says whether the 2D analysis is plane stress or plane strain.

plane strain
